heapq Dijkstra with per-query virtual START/END handled outside the shared graph.
Node path to SPEC 6.3 steps and summary.

tests.test: Full suite: 200+ pass; tests/planner passes with Postgres unreachable.

design_decisions.decision: Route data and graph held on app.state, reloaded in tests by calling main.load_route_data; rejected a reload endpoint.
Virtual start/end handled inside Dijkstra as synthetic edges; rejected mutating the shared adjacency lists.
Stop search ordered with COLLATE "C" in SQL to match Python sort in the memory fallback.
Plan params taken as raw strings and parsed in the router for 400 instead of FastAPI float validation (422).
stops_passed = number of stops after the boarding stop, up to and including alight stop.

implementation.self_critique: Memory fallback for /api/stops is only tested via db_down; transfer-by-walk and pre-ride at-to-at walk branches in steps.py are lightly covered. Docs (README rows, DECISIONS) not updated.
